facts.statement: The genus Maledictosuchus was described by Parrilla-Bel and colleagues in 2013.
The genus includes two species: the type species M. riclaensis and M. nuyivijanan, which was described in 2018.
facts.quote: subdivision: M. riclaensis Parrilla-Bel et al., 2013 (type) M. nuyivijanan Barrientos-Lara et al., 2018

facts.statement: Fossils of Maledictosuchus date from the Middle and Late Jurassic periods.
Maledictosuchus was a marine crocodyliform belonging to the family Metriorhynchidae.
facts.quote: Maledictosuchus is an extinct genus of marine crocodyliform belonging to the family Metriorhynchidae.

facts.statement: The species M. nuyivijanan is known from the Late Jurassic (Kimmeridgian) Sabinal Formation in the Tlaxiaco Basin, Oaxaca, Mexico.
facts.quote: M. nuyivijanan, known from the Late Jurassic (Kimmeridgian) Sabinal Formation (Tlaxiaco Basin, Oaxaca, Mexico).

facts.statement: Maledictosuchus lived in Spain during the Middle Jurassic (Middle Callovian).
facts.quote: que vivió en España durante el Jurásico Medio (Calloviense medio).

facts.statement: Maledictosuchus is classified within the subfamily Metriorhynchinae of the family Metriorhynchidae.
The time range for Maledictosuchus is from the Callovian to the Kimmeridgian, between 165.3 and 149.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Callovian to Kimmeridgian (165.3 to 149.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Maledictosuchus is the most basal member of the Rhacheosaurini tribe and had a body length of 2.95 meters based on the type specimen.
rejected.quote: It is the most basal member of the Rhacheosaurini Tribe with a relatively short body length, measuring 2.95 m based on the type specimen.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'the most basal member of the Rhacheosaurini tribe'
